task_summary: Resolved 60-second plagiarism check failure on 18-page academic research paper ('Elevation-Aware Domain Adaptation for Semantic Segmentation of Aerial Images', remotesensing-17-02529.pdf). Aligned architecture with canonical BAAI/bge-m3 specifications (batch_size=16, max_length=8192, dense_dim=1024, memory footprint=~1.2GB, CPU thread clamp=2). Implemented 2.5s fast OCR probe and failure cooldown in ocrExtraction.service.js, eliminated MinIO 404 retries by pre-filtering candidate corpus in archivePlagiarismScan.service.js, wrapped semantic scoring with 2.5s timeout with automatic Karp-Rabin Winnowing fallback, made BullMQ engine timeout configurable, and modernized frontend scanner badges.
